title: YudxxHub
description: Simple Velocity hub teleport with custom commands and more...
body:
**_YudxxHub_**​

Only Java17 + Can use this plugin
​
Set your own return commands — /lobby, /spawn, anything you want.
Fallback server if hub is down.
Every message editable.

Just /YudxxHub shows help. Any other command you define sends players home.

Commands

/YudxxHub — show help

/YudxxHub list — see all servers

/YudxxHub help — quick help

/YudxxHub reload — reload config (admin)
Permissions

yudxxhub.use — use hub commands
yudxxhub.admin — reload config

Config
hub-server: hub
return-commands:
- /lobby
- /hub
- /spawn
- /l
enable-messages: true
enable-fallback: true
fallback-server: lobby
messages:
  no-permission: '&cYou don''t have permission to use this command!'
  teleporting: '&aTeleporting you to the hub...'
  already-on-hub: '&eYou are already on the hub server!'
  hub-not-found: '&cHub server is currently unavailable!'
  teleport-success: '&aYou have been teleported to the hub!'
  teleport-failed: '&cFailed to teleport you to the hub!'
  fallback-teleport: '&eTeleporting you to fallback server: &f{server}'
  reload-success: '&aConfiguration reloaded successfully!'
  reload-failed: '&cFailed to reload configuration!'
message-toggles:
  teleporting: true
  already-on-hub: true
  teleport-success: true
  teleport-failed: true
  fallback-teleport: true

Lightweight. Clean. Works.
